   1|1. GENERAL

   3|Laser and Particle Beams, vol. 12, no. 2, pp. 223-244 (1994). In case you use results of the SNOP code, please quote the reference given above.
   4|
   5|The SNOP source code is in  the directory Snop/source. In order to install it
   6|on a IBM workstation, make this directory the working directory and use the
   7|command 'make risc'. After a successful preprocessing and compilation of the
   8|source code you will find an executable file called snoprisc in the directory
   9|Snop/Risc. The program reads the input (using fortan namelist input: daten)
  10|from a file called SNOP.INPUT and produces two output files:
  11|SNOP.INHALT: Gives a list of all the input parameters and option that
  12|              were chosen for the special run.
  13|SNOP.TAB:    Contains the tables in MULTI-format.
  14|
